1. `crates/djls-conf/src/lib.rs` (`LOG_DIR` static) — `Utf8PathBuf::from_path_buf(proj_dirs.cache_dir().to_path_buf()).unwrap()` panics if the OS cache dir isn't valid UTF-8. A startup-time panic over a path-encoding edge case is a disproportionate failure mode for logging setup. Fix: fall back to the `/tmp` (or temp-dir) path on `None` from `from_path_buf` instead of unwrapping.

2. `crates/djls-conf/src/lib.rs` (`LOG_DIR` as `LazyLock<Utf8PathBuf>`) — making this a process-wide lazily-initialized constant (per the "change log_dir to const" checklist item) regresses testability and flexibility versus the function the maintainer asked for. It can't be parameterized/mocked, so both the "XDG present" and "XDG absent" code paths can never both be exercised in the same test binary, and there's no way to honor `XDG_CACHE_HOME` overrides at call time. Revert to a plain function (e.g. `pub fn log_dir() -> Utf8PathBuf`) as originally implemented and as the maintainer's comment implied.

3. `crates/djls-conf/src/lib.rs` (`log_dir_tests` module) — the two new tests are effectively tautological: `test_log_dir_returns_path` asserts `contains("djls") || dir == "/tmp"`, which is true for almost any plausible implementation, and `test_log_dir_xdg_pattern` just re-derives `ProjectDirs` and checks the same string again — neither exercises the actual fallback branch or catches a regression. Needs a real test that forces each branch deterministically (e.g. by factoring the "XDG dir vs fallback" logic into a pure function taking `Option<ProjectDirs>`/cache-dir input so both branches are unit-testable without touching the real environment).

4. `crates/djls-server/src/logging.rs` (`init_tracing`) — if `create_dir_all(log_dir)` fails, the code only does `eprintln!` and then proceeds to construct the rolling file appender against a directory that doesn't exist, silently losing all file-based logging for the entire server session with no recovery. Fix: on directory-creation failure, fall back to a known-writable location (e.g. `std::env::temp_dir()`) rather than pressing on with a broken path.

5. `crates/djls-conf/src/lib.rs` (`LOG_DIR` fallback) and `crates/djls-server` — the fallback is hardcoded as the string `/tmp`, which doesn't exist on Windows. Since this PR explicitly adds cross-platform XDG support, the fallback should use `std::env::temp_dir()` instead of a Unix-only literal.

6. `crates/djls-conf/src/lib.rs` — `ProjectDirs::from("", "", "djls")` is now duplicated between `Settings::new` (config dir) and `LOG_DIR` (cache dir) with no shared helper, so the qualifier/org/app triple can drift between the two call sites. Factor out a small private `fn project_dirs() -> Option<ProjectDirs>` used by both.
